purpose: Test natural-parameter, anchored orthogonal residual, and partial-pooling estimators without modifying frozen release protocols.

estimand.target: CATE of conversion on Criteo v2.1
estimand.auxiliary_effect_scale: conditional log odds ratio for DINA internal estimation only

data_roles.screen: 15% development, same source rows for both fold seeds
data_roles.finalist: 100% development only for candidates passing screen on both fold seeds
data_roles.confirmation: requires a new randomized campaign; Sprint 2 confirmation is forbidden

protocol_amendments.reason: The first code-path-only attempt hit the preregistered 75% system-memory guard at 75.1%; no selection result was read and no model hyperparameter changed.

The first 15% screen attempt stopped after shared nuisance fitting, before any candidate score existed, at 75.8% system memory with 3.68 GB still available. The independent absolute floor remains 2 GB.

The first full-development finalist attempt stopped after shared nuisance fitting, before any candidate score existed, at 80.6% system memory with 2.94 GB still available. The independent absolute floor remains 2 GB.

The combined full-development run retained a 1.84 GB process high-water mark and stopped at 85.1% during the second candidate. The finalist set was already frozen; each candidate is rerun in a fresh process and deterministic OOF artifacts are merged only after exact contract checks.

On this approximately 15.2 GB host, 87% used corresponds to the independently retained 2 GB absolute floor. The isolated Sentinel retry stopped before candidate scoring at 85.1% despite 2.26 GB available; aligning the redundant percentage guard avoids contradictory rounding behavior.

metrics.inference: paired bootstrap on identical OOF rows
metrics.scale_rule: DINA is converted from log odds ratio to absolute CATE before primary evaluation

selection_rule.screening: finite nonconstant OOF score and at least 200 control conversions
selection_rule.advance: policy_area_dr greater than Response on both registered fold seeds
selection_rule.finalist: run 100% development OOF for advancing registered candidates plus Response
selection_rule.promotion: requires a new randomized confirmation campaign with paired 95% CI lower bound greater than zero

causal_forest.reason: Complete and validate common theory/experiment foundation before another Kaggle run.

candidates.name: Response
candidates.hypothesis: Frozen champion and mandatory ranking reference.

candidates.name: Anchored-R25
candidates.hypothesis: Preserve prognostic ranking and learn only a strongly shrunk orthogonal treatment residual.

candidates.name: Anchored-R25-Sentinel
candidates.hypothesis: Expose structural point masses only to the residual learner while retaining the risk anchor.

candidates.name: Anchored-Pattern-R
candidates.hypothesis: Partial-pool the causal residual across the 53 observed sentinel structures.

candidates.name: DINA-CATE-Sentinel
candidates.hypothesis: Estimate heterogeneous log odds ratio with orthogonal Bernoulli likelihood, then map it back to absolute CATE.
